name: Goliath
reviewNotes: Powerful Build grants advantage on ability checks to end Grappled, not an automatic 3.5e opposed-grapple size modifier or oversized-weapon permission. Exact interplay with the native opposed grapple procedure remains part of combat-integration review.
Large Form uses the native actual Large size category, not historical automatic 3.5e AC/grapple modifiers; reach and occupancy follow the native spatial rules.
The standing-jump portion of 3.5e Mountain Movement and high-altitude acclimation are selected. No compulsory Ordning status or Upbringing choice is granted by biology.

Giant creature type selected in the comparative Species review. Size remains Medium. Giant-specific targeting applies, but Giant monster stat-block defaults and Humanoid targeting via hierarchy parentage are not automatically inherited.
